findings.title: `sanitizeSearchTerm` does not strip PostgREST `.` operator separators
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/api/src/lib/search.ts:26-36 strips `,()."\\%*`, collapses whitespace and caps at 100 chars; sanitize-search.test.ts covers a.eq.b / a*b / injection strings. Residual (documented): literal dots are intentionally unsearchable.

findings.title: Admin global search exposes profile PII and never tenant-scopes the organizations query
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: organizations are scoped to the caller's orgs unless a true super admin (apps/api/src/routes/search.ts:191-201) and the PII projection is gated to super admins (search.ts:110-140); regression tests search.test.ts and search-tenant-scope.test.ts.

findings.title: Raw search terms persisted in plaintext `audit_logs.metadata`
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: search.ts:241-261 audits only a truncated SHA-256 queryHash, queryLength and result counts - never the raw term.

findings.title: Portal search omits documents despite SDK and documentation contract
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: apps/api/src/routes/search-portal.ts:76-84 queries documents with the can_read_document visibility filter; SDK PortalSearchResult includes documents (packages/sdk/src/search.ts:37-52); docs/modules/search-portal.md documents it.

findings.title: Admin search UI silently discards the documents result set
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: AdminGlobalSearch.tsx:19-27,57-65,76 renders the documents group and counts it; PortalGlobalSearch.tsx:158-168 renders portal documents too.

findings.title: No search pagination or result counts; hard 5-result ceiling
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5, still partial: the admin route accepts ?limit (default 5, cap 25) and returns per-entity exact counts (search.ts:33,265-285), surfaced in the SDK (search.ts:20-40) and OpenAPI (spec.ts:1087-1105). Residual: the portal route still uses a fixed RESULT_LIMIT=5 with no counts/offset (search-portal.ts:20,94-100), documented as fixed-5 in the SDK (search.ts:43) and docs/modules/search-portal.md.

findings.title: Search query analytics metric is dead and the analytics summary RPC is missing
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: recordSearchQuery() is called by both routes (search.ts:263, search-portal.ts:94) and get_analytics_summary is defined service-role-only in supabase/migrations/5302440_search_analytics_summary.sql:19-33.

findings.title: Prefix/wildcard mismatch: no btree on prefix columns and no full-text (`tsvector`) search
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: migration 5302456 adds btree + trigram indexes (organizations.slug/name, profiles.full_name, documents.name/mime_type) and stored generated tsvector columns + GIN for tickets/projects/documents; both routes OR a search_vector.wfts(english) branch (search.ts:59, search-portal.ts:35-37).

findings.title: Typeahead calls full search endpoints without rate limiting or a dedicated autocomplete surface
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: rateLimitSearch (60/min per user/ip, middleware/rate-limit.ts:84) is mounted first on both routes (search.ts:20, search-portal.ts:12-14).

findings.title: Admin global search returns private/internal documents without applying the `can_read_document` visibility filter
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: admin search filters documents through filterReadableDocuments with a bounded over-fetch (search.ts:166-185,228-233) and reports the readable subset as the count for non-super-admins (search.ts:275-285); the code mirror matches the SQL helper 5302129 (lib/document-visibility.ts:186-230); tests search-document-visibility.test.ts.

findings.title: Search router bypasses the org-pinned admin check, so a tenant admin can read another tenant's search results
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the middleware order is requireAuth, requireOrgAccess, requireAdmin (search.ts:22-27) so the org-pinned admin check applies; an explicit organization narrows the search and an absent org never widens it (search.ts:101-108); regression tests search-org-pin.test.ts.

findings.title: Soft-delete columns are defined but never used by queries or deletes
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: the unused deleted_at/deleted_by columns and indexes were dropped (supabase/migrations/5302432_drop_unused_soft_delete_columns.sql) and no runtime search code reads them.

findings.title: Search module documentation is stale relative to the code
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: docs/modules/search.md documents scoping, limit/counts, FTS, visibility filtering and the hashed audit; docs/modules/search-portal.md matches the route (fixed-5, documents, rate limit, metric).

findings.title: Search SDK and OpenAPI contracts do not cover the implemented response (documents, counts, limit)
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5: packages/sdk/src/search.ts:1-60 models SearchDocument/SearchCounts/limit and PortalSearchResult documents; apps/api/src/openapi/spec.ts:1007-1107 documents both routes' documents/counts shapes.

findings.title: Portal search queries are not audit-logged, unlike the admin search route
findings.note: re-verified at 6b7aa1a5, now closed: the portal route emits the same privacy-preserving audit event as admin search - truncated SHA-256 queryHash, queryLength, surface='portal' and per-entity resultCounts, never the raw term (search-portal.ts:96-117); regression test search-portal.test.ts:142-180. Residual note: the event has no organization_id (the route spans the user's memberships), so org-scoped audit readers cannot see it; platform admins can.

report: Read-only re-verification at 6b7aa1a5. 14/15 previous SEARCH findings are verified fixed and 1 is partially fixed (SEARCH-P2-004: admin limit/counts landed, portal remains fixed-5 with no counts/offset); 0 regressed, 0 new. SEARCH-P3-004 closed in this diff: portal searches now write a hashed (SHA-256, 16 hex chars) audit event with query length and per-entity result counts, and the new test asserts the raw term never reaches audit_logs. No new search/privacy issues were identified; the remaining portal pagination gap is the same residual as the prior run and is documented in the SDK. Executed: read both search routes, sanitizer, document-visibility helper, SDK/OpenAPI contracts and migrations 5302432/5302440/5302456; ran the new search-portal test sources.
